sections.title: THE GAME
sections.content: **Space Age Racer** is a racing game inspired by the **podracers from Star Wars**. You take on rival pods across deserts, forests and icy wastelands. I made it for fun, to race with my friends while learning more about **Unity and Arduino**.

sections.title: THE CONTROLLER
sections.content: The idea was a **homemade arcade game**, played on [a custom controller](media:-2) I built myself. Each lever of the controller drives one engine: give one more power than the other and the pod turns. A button on the right handle adds a boost.

sections.title: DESIGN CHALLENGES
sections.content: I developed the whole game in Unity. The real challenge was making the pods **feel natural to drive**, which meant iterating a lot on the physics, the camera and the controls. I also built several **prototype tracks** to test different ideas, with my friends as playtesters. Little by little, racing started to feel fun.
